reviewer: Captain (implementation finding; not a counsel approval)
question: The Grade-A renderer required every component presented as a pleading to carry its own caption. Is that a valid universal rule about court documents, and if not, what decides a component's caption?
finding: Not valid, and the corpus says so. Of 51 court-facing components, 42 declare no caption section, and they are not one kind of thing. A single rule keyed on presentation can only be satisfied two ways where it does not fit — manufacture a caption, or relabel a court-facing filing as guidance — and both are forbidden. Caption behaviour is a property of the component, so it moved into the §4.2 document contract.

values.full_independent_caption: the component carries its own caption naming the court and the case.
values.supporting_page: a page filed WITH a captioned instrument and identified by it, carrying no caption of its own.
values.official_form_controls: an official form supplies the caption, so the composer neither writes nor requires one.
values.not_applicable: the component is not court-facing, so no caption arises.
values.unresolved: nothing read establishes which of the above is true. A court-facing component in this state refuses.

theContract.derivedOnlyWhereASourceFieldStatesIt: official_pdf_fill yields official_form_controls; process_guidance yields not_applicable. custom_pleading yields unresolved, because 'a custom pleading is permitted' says nothing about whether this particular component carries a caption. Nothing is inferred from presentation.

renderInvariant.now: court-facing && captionTreatment === 'unresolved' -> refuse; and captionTreatment === 'full_independent_caption' && no caption block -> refuse as a derivation defect
renderInvariant.whereItRuns: over every document before anything is drawn, not inside the pleading path, because a court-facing component presented as guidance raises the same question and must not escape it.

nevadaFirst.question: Was the captionless declaration itself part of the owner-adopted output bytes and component set?
nevadaFirst.method: Read the adopted output directly (pdftotext over the census-v1 canonical fixture), rather than reasoning from the build script alone.
nevadaFirst.answer: Yes. The adopted packet is one document of nine pages carrying all eight components. Page 7 is the declaration. It opens "This declaration accompanies the subsection 2 petition" and carries no court line, no in-the-matter-of line and no case number — while page 4 (the petition) and page 6 (the proposed order) each carry a full caption with participant-completable blanks.
nevadaFirst.corroboration: FIX07 (data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/fix07/nv-seal-probation-pagination-return.json) independently records page 7 as declaration_and_verification starting with a substantive heading, in both the canonical and boundary fixtures.
nevadaFirst.determination: The adoption establishes the caption behaviour. The declaration is a supporting page with no independent caption, and that exact treatment is encoded. No caption was manufactured for it, and it was not relabelled as guidance.
nevadaFirst.digestCaveat: The on-disk canonical fixture hashes 3b02d62f…, the adopted bytes were 533cf8ec… and FIX07 rebuilt them to 8fe5e209…. The structural facts relied on here — which components exist, which pages carry captions — are identical across all three vintages and are independently recorded by FIX07. The digest drift itself is a separate matter: the adoption's own condition is that a shipping-artifact digest change requires re-review, and whether that re-review happened is not resolved here.

boundedClassificationPass.method: One pass over the existing authoritative and adopted records. No new audit framework and no fresh legal research. A treatment is recorded only where an AUTHORITY establishes it — a controlling official or local form, adopted or approved artifact bytes, a source-backed document specification, or an owner or legal decision — or where a source field on the document states it. See correction1 below: the first version of this pass used a weaker rule and was corrected.
boundedClassificationPass.whatWasDeliberatelyNotDone: A packet-level caption test was run over the census-v1 fixtures and then discarded as a classifier. It reports that 12 of 13 families' approved artifacts contain a caption somewhere — which is true and useless, because Nevada is the counterexample in its own packet: captions on pages 4 and 6, none on page 7. A packet-level signal cannot classify a component, and using it would have been exactly the blunt inference this correction removes.

not_applicable.basis: derived from outputStrategy process_guidance; court-facing but not a filing

full_independent_caption.basis: adopted or approved artifact bytes, read page by page and cited per component in documentContract.captionTreatmentEvidence. See correction1 for each route's evidence and for the rule that replaced the original basis.
full_independent_caption.note: MS non-conviction is the live commercial route and IL felony-prostitution is the one commercially eligible family that composes and renders through this path. The new invariant caught both before it landed; each is bound to its approved artifact, and both render unchanged.

supporting_page.basis: the owner-adopted output read page by page, corroborated by FIX07's independent page census. Cited in documentContract.captionTreatmentEvidence.

unresolved.why: 27 of them declare a single approved_shipping_component section, which describes an approved component rather than carrying its text, so they do not compose at all. See correction2. The rest declare no sections, or declare sections that carry no caption. None is unresolved on purpose; unresolved means no authority has been recorded yet.
unresolved.allSixAreNoncommercial: and each is already on the board for its own reason: DC has a specification but no packet plan; both Kansas specifications record legalSectionsBound false; the ND reviews are stale; VA's caseMode is unresolved because its instrument may be an administrative transmittal rather than a petition.

boundedClassificationPass.oneSignalWorthRecording: VA:regime-1's approved artifact carries no caption anywhere in the packet, unlike every other family tested. That is consistent with the open question already recorded about whether its instrument opens a civil docket at all, and it is the first place to look when VA's batch comes up.

control: scripts/verify-caption-treatment-contract.mjs. Two positive controls and two negative, because an invariant that only refuses is satisfied by refusing everything: (A) an independently captioned filing renders; (B) an approved supporting page with no caption of its own renders, in the same packet as captioned filings, while still being court-facing rather than reclassified; (C) a court-facing component with an unresolved treatment refuses; (D) a component that declares a full caption and carries none refuses as a derivation defect. It also proves the treatment is not a restatement of presentation, and that the same unresolved value on a non-court-facing component does not refuse.
remainingReview: Counsel review of Nevada's supporting-page treatment, and per-component caption classification for the 35 unresolved components, remain required. No route is opened, no artifact is approved and no digest is re-signed by this record.

correction1_implementationIsNotItsOwnAut.whatWasWrong: The first pass classified a component full_independent_caption because its own composition emits a caption block today. That proves what the renderer does, not what the document should carry, and it is how a legacy behaviour validates itself. The rule was wrong even where the conclusion happened to be right.
correction1_implementationIsNotItsOwnAut.ruleNow: Every RECORDED caption treatment must cite one of: a controlling official or local form, adopted or approved artifact bytes, a source-backed document specification, or an owner or legal decision. It is recorded in documentContract.captionTreatmentEvidence and enforced by control, including a check that rejects evidence phrased as what the implementation currently emits.

recheckOfTheSeven.evidence: Approved artifact bytes, digest-verified. The fulfillment record pins participant_delivery_canonical at sha256 413f6226500a5dc13cbad2ce7ec664a55dcdb48d80cd8bef9fa746f369c6553f with artifactApprovalStatus participant_delivery_exact_hashes_approved_held_for_technical_preview_acceptance. The file on disk matches that digest exactly, and pages 2, 5 and 9 each open with the full caption block (CITY OF JACKSON / PLAINTIFF / VS. / CASE NO. / DEFENDANT-PETITIONER) for the petition, the order and the service component respectively.

recheckOfTheSeven.verdict: resolved on authority, after a closer look that nearly went the other way
recheckOfTheSeven.evidence: OWNER_BATCH_ADOPTION_2026-09-02 adopts il-prostitution-j-vacate-set and names it in none of the eight withholding answers. The bytes on disk are NOT the adopted ones: the adopted canonical digest is 7daaa389709afebccd46cdcee56b16c9888eb4ddcda2475c6c1e0b7315b9517d and the file is d4cb765983ed2ed180a74feb1a70b7b5cc43134419b2c497746d8fd188bd2657, the artifact-rereview-20260914 vintage, whose status is INSPECTED_FOR_OWNER_REVIEW_NOT_APPROVED. That alone would have sent this back to unresolved. What saves it is that the re-review publishes its own diff, and the entire change is one explanatory sentence added below JUDGE on page 3, with pages 1 and 2 rendering identically. The motion caption is on page 1 and the order caption on page 3 above the added line, so both are byte-identical to the approved bytes and the adoption covers them.
recheckOfTheSeven.separateMatter: The IL shipping-artifact digest drift itself remains recorded and unapproved. It does not touch the caption and is not cleared here.

recheckOfTheSeven.evidence: The adopted output read page by page, plus the owner-adopted build host that composed it, plus FIX07 independently recording the page census and stating that the only post-adoption change was removal of a route footer from proposed_order, with no substantive change.

correction1_implementationIsNotItsOwnAut.outcome: All eight recorded treatments survive the recheck, but on corrected bases. None now rests on renderer output, and the control makes that permanent: stripping the evidence from one component reds it, and so does phrasing the evidence as what the composer emits.

correction2_approvedShippingComponent.question: Are the components carrying an approved_shipping_component section a shared composer capability gap, or a route-specific content gap?
correction2_approvedShippingComponent.answer: B, route-specific content — but with a shared cause that is already fixed.
correction2_approvedShippingComponent.whatTheMarkerIs: A DESCRIPTION of an approved component: a heading naming what it contains — for example "Caption and motion", or "the numbered eligibility statements under section 35-3-37(j)(7), the pardon, the petitioner's own statement, and the request for restriction" — plus the field ids it uses. No body, no assertions, no text.
correction2_approvedShippingComponent.whyNoGenericHandler: There is nothing authoritative in the marker to render. A generic handler could only invent the motion's words, which is the one thing the composer may never do. This is exactly the case the instruction named: do not invent a generic renderer where the section type does not carry enough authoritative content.
correction2_approvedShippingComponent.whereTheContentIs: It exists, upstream, per family. All 8 families carrying this kind — DC actual-innocence, GA pardon-J7, GA SB-288, IL mistaken-identity, MS 9-11-15-3, MS 99-19-71-1, SD SIS, WY 7-13-1502 — have a census-v1 build host that composed the adopted artifact. Five carry their composed text inline; three delegate to a shared regional host.
correction2_approvedShippingComponent.therefore: Each is the same derivation defect Nevada had: the specification kept the description and dropped the substance. The fix is per family, in its own §5 batch, by transcribing the adopted text. That is 36 documents across 8 families, not 36 separate problems.
correction2_approvedShippingComponent.theSharedPartIsAlreadyDone: Transcription needs shared composer capabilities, and those were built for Nevada and are reused rather than rebuilt: the declaration section kind, labelled participant-completable blanks after numbered assertions, and the explicit caption contract. So this is 8 transcriptions and not 8 bespoke renderers, and no custom workaround is warranted for any of them.
correction2_approvedShippingComponent.sharedCorrectionMade: The composer now refuses an approved_shipping_component section by its real cause rather than as an unimplemented kind. The old message read "this composer does not implement", which invites someone to implement it. The new one names the section, says it describes an approved component rather than carrying its text, points at the family build host, and says the substance was dropped in derivation. That is the one-time shared fix this population warranted.

stillOutstanding: Transcribe the adopted text for the 8 families carrying approved_shipping_component, per family, in their §5 batches: 5 from a build host proven to reproduce the adopted artifact, 3 from the adopted substance using the recorded characterisation of their drift. Preserve adopted component membership and requirement state independently of the text; do not draft missing substance.
Per-component caption classification for the remaining unresolved court-facing components, from each family's own approved artifact page by page.
The IL felony-prostitution shipping-artifact digest drift, and Nevada's, remain recorded and unapproved. Neither affects the caption classification, and neither is cleared here.
Counsel review of Nevada's supporting-page treatment.

correction3_transcriptionProvenance.rule: A census-v1 build host is a transcription source only where its output still corresponds to what the owner adopted. It is not authority merely because it exists. Illinois felony-prostitution already showed the failure mode: its shipping bytes drifted after adoption, the record of that drift is explicitly not an approval, and transcribing from the current host would have carried an unapproved post-adoption edit into production wearing the adoption's authority.
correction3_transcriptionProvenance.method: Per family, hash the on-disk canonical fixture and compare it to the digest OWNER_BATCH_ADOPTION_2026-09-02 pins for that family. Where they differ, look for a committed record that names the current digest. Three states result, and a family that has already had text carried into it while in the worst state is a failure.

states.matches_adopted: the on-disk canonical fixture hashes to the adopted digest, so the build host reproduces the adopted artifact and is a proven source.
states.drift_characterised: the bytes moved and a committed record names the current digest and says what changed. Transcribe the ADOPTED substance, using the characterisation to know what the current host adds or moves.
states.drift_uncharacterised: the bytes moved and nothing committed explains them. Recover the approved content or version first; do not transcribe.

correction3_transcriptionProvenance.whatThisProves: Traceability, never approval. A characterised drift is still an unapproved drift; it is simply one whose contents are known.

drift_characterised: MS:additional-justice-court-misdemeanor-relief-9-11-15-3 (5) — OWNER_ARTIFACT_REREVIEW_MS_ADDITIONAL_MISDEMEANOR_2026-09-14 records the change as pagination-only, whitespace-normalized words identical, a 21-word parenthetical moved from page 3 to page 4, eight pages retained, status INSPECTED_FOR_OWNER_REVIEW_NOT_APPROVED
theEightFamilies.note: No family is blocked outright today. The guard exists so that one appearing later is caught rather than transcribed.

nevadaOwnProvenance.why: Nevada is the family already transcribed, so its own chain had to be established rather than assumed.
chain: FIX07 -> 8fe5e209783ff5f70a18f8a37045f25126b020b23373aeba98956347440cd041, 9 pages. Removed the participant-irrelevant internal route footer from the proposed_order component only, and records: no legal theory, component, filing destination, fee, service statement, or substantive instruction changed.

FIX72 -> 3b02d62f748c5f3ec5150742f3e225d0418ca4ddb7203ef5bc7fce9552b2de9a, 9 pages. Records that pdftotext of both fixtures before and after differ in exactly the final stop bullet of the referral page, with page counts and recorded page manifests unchanged.
nevadaOwnProvenance.consequenceForTheTranscription: Neither hop touches the three components whose text was carried. FIX07 changed a route footer on the proposed order, which is not pleading text; FIX72 changed one bullet on referral_instructions, which is a component deliberately left untranscribed because it already composed from a top-level specification block. So the petition, the proposed order and the declaration are the adopted substance.
nevadaOwnProvenance.honestResidual: Both hops are characterised and neither is an owner re-approval. Nevada's shipping-artifact digest still differs from the adopted one, and the adoption's own condition is that such a change requires re-review. That re-review is not performed or claimed here.

correction3_transcriptionProvenance.control: scripts/verify-transcription-provenance.mjs. Classifies every family carrying approved_shipping_component and every family already transcribed, prints the digest movement and the records that explain it, and fails if a family with uncharacterised drift has transcribed text in its specification. Mutation-proven: making Nevada's drift look unexplained while its text is transcribed reds it twice.

refinement_perComponentNotPerFamily.rule: drift_characterised at family level does not authorize the current build host as a transcription source. A characterisation is evidence about what changed; a change elsewhere in the packet certifies nothing about the page being copied. The decision is per component.

perComponentStates.exact_adopted_bytes: the family's source reproduces the adopted artifact exactly, so no per-component argument is needed. Available only where the family is matches_adopted.
perComponentStates.untouched_by_drift: the family drifted and the recorded change does not reach this component at all. The record naming what changed has to say so.
perComponentStates.drift_outside_substance: the recorded change reaches this component but not the substance carried — a machine footer, a page break — and the record says so in terms.
perComponentStates.recovered_from_adopted: the drift reaches this component's substance, so the text was recovered from the adopted version rather than copied from current bytes. Always available, including where drift is uncharacterised.

refinement_perComponentNotPerFamily.recordedWhere: packet specification, per document, as transcriptionProvenance { adoptedDigest, sourceUsed, componentEquivalence, evidence }.
refinement_perComponentNotPerFamily.enforcement: verify-transcription-provenance.mjs now audits every component this program carries in: it must record a binding, the equivalence it claims must be one its family's state can support, the named adopted digest must be the one the adoption pins, and any claim short of exact adopted bytes must argue for itself. Mutation-proven three ways: removing a binding reds it; a component in a drifted family claiming exact adopted bytes reds it twice; and asserting untouched with no argument reds it.
refinement_perComponentNotPerFamily.scope: The covered set is this program's own work — the eight families that carried approved_shipping_component, plus Nevada, which was transcribed first. Specification text predating the program (MS non-conviction, ND, VA) is deliberately out of scope: this control governs what the program carries in, and claiming provenance for text it did not carry would assert something nobody established.

nevadaAppliedRetroactively.why: Nevada is the precedent every other family will follow, so its own components were bound rather than grandfathered.
nevadaAppliedRetroactively.five_untouched_by_drift: detection_and_routing, branch_screen, discharge_type_screen, primary_filing, declaration_and_verification. FIX07 names proposed_order only; FIX72 names the referral page only. Neither names these.
nevadaAppliedRetroactively.one_drift_outside_substance: proposed_order is the single component a post-adoption change reaches, so it is not claimed untouched. FIX07 removed the internal route footer, which the build host appends after all component text and outside the pleading substance; the completion note, caption, ordering paragraphs, agency list and subsection 4 sentence are untouched, and FIX07 records in terms that no legal theory, component, filing destination, fee, service statement or substantive instruction changed.

howTheEightProceed.five_matches_adopted: DC actual-innocence, GA pardon-J7, GA SB-288, SD SIS, WY 1502 — the current host reproduces the adopted artifact, so it may supply the text and each component records exact_adopted_bytes.
howTheEightProceed.three_drifted: IL mistaken-identity, MS 9-11-15-3, MS 99-19-71-1 — the current host may supply a component only where that component is proven untouched or the change is proven outside the substance carried, each recorded with its evidence. Where neither is established, recover the component from the adopted version. A family-level characterisation is not a pass for the whole packet.
howTheEightProceed.alwaysAndRegardless: Preserve adopted component membership and requirement state independently of text recovery, and draft no missing legal substance. This remains 8 family derivation repairs, not 36 handcrafted court documents.

sourceToArtifactBridge.rule: matches_adopted proves the FIXTURE equals the adopted artifact. It does not prove that today's build host is what produced those bytes: a host can be edited without anyone regenerating, and the fixture would go on matching the adoption while the source claiming to produce it no longer does. So exact_adopted_bytes may be claimed from a current host only with a direct bridge — (A) regenerate the family from that host and show the artifact digest equals the adopted digest, or (B) take the text from the exact historical or adopted source version bound to the approved artifact.
sourceToArtifactBridge.routeARun: Performed once per exact-match family, non-destructively, with the tree restored afterwards and verified clean.

proven: WY:felony-conviction-expungement-w-s-7-13-1502 — regenerated in place; the canonical fixture hashed 3dcdbc4ec3d9f08b6c6302b84f254663aa9302a4f712d7451000e2ecda302e30 before and after, which is the digest the adoption pins, and nothing in the family directory changed.

SD:suspended-imposition-of-sentence-sealing — regenerated in place; both fixtures came back byte-identical and the canonical digest is the one the adoption pins. Only build metadata moved, because the run used --no-raster, and it was restored.
unavailable: DC:dc_actual_innocence_expungement_16_803 — the build host asserts the Master Library corpus is mounted at private/source-imports/Expungement_AI_RCAP_Master_Library_Edition_1 and refuses without it.
GA:restriction-and-sealing-of-a-pardoned-felony — same corpus assertion, via the shared GA host.
GA:sb-288-misdemeanor-conviction-restriction-and-sealing — same corpus assertion, via the shared GA host.

sourceToArtifactBridge.whatTheUnavailableThreeMean: Not a new blocker. The corpus mount is the existing GA-8-22E1 external blocker already on the board. Those three take route B — transcribe from the adopted artifact — or wait for the mount and then regenerate. Either way exact_adopted_bytes is not claimable from their current hosts today.
sourceToArtifactBridge.enforcement: verify-transcription-provenance.mjs fails any component claiming exact_adopted_bytes from a source path under scripts/ whose family has no proven regeneration bridge. Mutation-proven: a component making that claim reds three separate checks. Withdrawing a bridge that nothing claims does not fail, because the bridge is a precondition for a claim rather than a claim in itself.
sourceToArtifactBridge.honest: Two of five bridges are proven today. The rule is in force for all five, so the other three cannot quietly take the shortcut when their transcription comes up.

denominator.statement: Eight caption treatments are recorded on authority: SEVEN full_independent_caption and ONE supporting_page. Both numbers are true of this population and mean different things — seven components carry their own caption, and one is an approved supporting page that carries none.
denominator.assertedBy: scripts/verify-caption-treatment-contract.mjs prints and asserts the split rather than only the total, so it cannot become ambiguous later.
